description: Query and display package information from the local cache, without changing the system.

next.name: depends
tip: Show a listing of each dependency a package has.

option.name: --implicit
tip: Also show implicitly added dependencies, not only explicitly expressed ones.

option.name: --important
tip: Print only important dependencies.
For use with unmet and depends.

option.name: --installed
tip: Limit the output of depends and rdepends to installed packages.

option.name: --no-breaks
tip: Omit Breaks from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --no-conflicts
tip: Omit Conflicts from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --no-depends
tip: Omit Depends from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --no-enhances
tip: Omit Enhances from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --no-pre-depends
tip: Omit Pre-Depends from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --no-recommends
tip: Omit Recommends from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --no-replaces
tip: Omit Replaces from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --no-suggests
tip: Omit Suggests from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --recurse
tip: Print all mentioned packages recursively, each printed once.

next.name: dotty
tip: Generate GraphViz dotty output for package relationships.

next.name: dump
tip: Show a short listing of every package in the cache.
Primarily for debugging.

next.name: dumpavail
tip: Print an available list to stdout, suitable for dpkg.
Used by the dselect method.

next.name: gencaches
tip: Create the package cache, parsing package information from remote sources.

next.name: madison
tip: Display available versions of a package in a tabular format.

next.name: pkgnames
tip: Print the name of each package APT knows.
The optional prefix filters the name list.

option.name: --all-names
tip: Print all names, including virtual packages and missing dependencies.

next.name: policy
tip: Show policy settings and priority selection.

next.name: rdepends
tip: Show a listing of each reverse dependency a package has.

option.name: --implicit
tip: Also show implicitly added dependencies, not only explicitly expressed ones.

option.name: --important
tip: Print only important dependencies.
For use with unmet and depends.

option.name: --installed
tip: Limit the output of depends and rdepends to installed packages.

option.name: --no-breaks
tip: Omit Breaks from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --no-conflicts
tip: Omit Conflicts from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --no-depends
tip: Omit Depends from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --no-enhances
tip: Omit Enhances from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --no-pre-depends
tip: Omit Pre-Depends from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --no-recommends
tip: Omit Recommends from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --no-replaces
tip: Omit Replaces from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --no-suggests
tip: Omit Suggests from the depends and rdepends output.

option.name: --recurse
tip: Print all mentioned packages recursively, each printed once.

next.name: search
tip: Search package names and descriptions for a POSIX regex pattern.
Separate arguments specify multiple patterns that are anded together.

option.name: --full
tip: Show full package records for each match.

option.name: --names-only
tip: Search package names only, not descriptions.

next.name: show
tip: Show package records for the named packages.

option.name: --all-versions
tip: Print full records for all available versions.
This is the default; use --no-all-versions to show only the candidate version.

option.name: --no-all-versions
tip: Show only the candidate version, not all available versions.

next.name: showpkg
tip: Display available versions, reverse dependencies and forward dependencies.

next.name: showsrc
tip: Show source package records matching the given package names.
All versions are shown.

option.name: --only-source
tip: Display only source package names.

next.name: stats
tip: Display statistics about the cache.
No further arguments are expected.

next.name: unmet
tip: Display a summary of all unmet dependencies in the package cache.

option.name: --important
tip: Print only important dependencies.
For use with unmet and depends.

next.name: xvcg
tip: Generate xvcg output for package relationships.
The same as dotty, only for the VCG tool.

global_option.name: --audit
tip: Show audit (and notice) messages.
Overrides the quiet option for notice messages, not progress ones.

global_option.name: --color
tip: Turn colors on.

global_option.name: --config-file
tip: Specify a configuration file to use.

global_option.name: --generate
tip: Perform automatic package cache regeneration.
This is the default; use --no-generate to turn it off.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Show a short usage summary.

global_option.name: --no-color
tip: Turn colors off.

global_option.name: --no-generate
tip: Do not regenerate the package cache automatically.

global_option.name: --option
tip: Set an arbitrary configuration option.
Syntax: -o Foo::Bar=bar. Can be used multiple times.

global_option.name: --pkg-cache
tip: Select the file to store the package cache.

global_option.name: --quiet
tip: Produce output suitable for logging, omitting progress indicators.

global_option.name: --src-cache
tip: Select the file to store the source cache.

global_option.name: --version
tip: Show the program version.

global_option.name: --with-source
tip: Add the given file as a source for metadata.
Can be repeated.
